Aeon chuckled.

**"To make an exchange."**

*"An offer, if you will."*

***"We are kin, after all."***

*"Not in form,* **nor by blood,** ***but kin nonetheless"***

*"No, we are joined by something greater."*

**"The bonds of HATE."**

*"You wish to see them destroyed? To take away everything from those who took everything from you?"*

**"We shall grant you that power. Take vengeance on those who have wronged you."**

"What is the price?"

*"Everything."*

**"But I don't think that bothers you anymore, does it?"**

The Eyes withdrew a Lance, still tipped with blood.

*"Take the lance that claimed your life."*

**Take your own with it once more."**

*"Become the Vengeance that courses through your veins."*

**"We shall do the rest."**

The Spectre picked up the lance, and hesitated.

*"What do you have left to live for, if not to exact your vengeance."*
